pages.title: Higgs Field Modulator
pages.text: The $(item)Higgs Field Modulator$() tunes the Higgs field locally to strip mass from matter - or make it negative.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 3$() machine.

Physics check: elementary particles get their rest mass from coupling to the Higgs field, confirmed at CERN in 2012. Most of the mass of ordinary matter is really binding energy of quarks and gluons. Tuning the field itself is pure speculation - and this machine does it anyway.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (4 item and 2 fluid inputs, 1 and 0 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Higgs Catalyst, Inertia Damper, Magnetic Monopole, Massless Alloy, Metastable Vacuum Lattice, Negative Mass Ingot, Topological Defect Core, True Vacuum Seed.
